title: Affine realization of a quasi-coherent algebra
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] whose underlying module is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist a scheme $X$, an affine morphism $f:X\to S$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_S$-algebras $\mathcal A\cong f_*\mathcal O_X$.

proof.text: For each affine U set F(U) = Spec A(U) and F(U → V) = Spec(A(V) → A(U)). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra-affine-inclusion] for the identity and composition laws and for the cartesian naturality squares of the maps F(U) → U. These define an equifibered natural transformation to the directed affine cover.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-relative-glueing-affine-opens], directly as Mathlib Scheme.Cover.RelativeGluingData: X is the colimit of F and f is d.toBase. Each preimage f^{-1}(U) equals the open range of the colimit inclusion F(U) → X by toBase_preimage_eq_opensRange_ι. This range is affine since F(U) is a spectrum, proving IsAffineHom f [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. The chart squares are d.isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase and their restriction compatibility is colimit.w.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-relative-spectrum-structure-algebra] to these cartesian spectral charts and their compatibility to obtain the isomorphism A ≅ f_* O_X. That theorem is proved in the delivery from Mathlib basis extension and spectrum sections naturality, without quasi-coherence assumptions or new unfinished statements.
